title: Restriction of scalars commutes with $j_!$
statement:
Let $a\colon\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings
([sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]) and $j\colon U\to X$ an open immersion. With $j_!$ the
extension by zero of module objects ([sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]) there is a natural
isomorphism

$$
\operatorname{Res}_{a_X}\circ j_!\;\cong\;j_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{a_U}\colon
\Mod_{\Lambda'_U}\longrightarrow\Mod_{\Lambda_X}.
$$

proof.text:
On module objects $j_!=(j_!)_{\Lambda_X}\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}$, the linearization of
the abelian $j_!$ through its projection formula with respect to $j^*$, after restriction of
scalars along $\alpha_j\colon j^*\Lambda_X\to\Lambda_U$ ([sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]). By
[def-sfb-projection-formula-comap] (with $S=j^*$, $\varphi=a_X$),
$\operatorname{Res}_{a_X}\circ(j_!)_{\Lambda'_X}\cong(j_!)_{\Lambda_X}\circ
\operatorname{Res}_{j^*a_X}$, so

$$
\operatorname{Res}_{a_X}\circ j_!\cong(j_!)_{\Lambda_X}\circ\operatorname{Res}_{j^*a_X}\circ
\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha'_j}\cong(j_!)_{\Lambda_X}\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha'_j\circ j^*a_X}.
$$
